criteria.rationale: The assessable delivered content fulfills the substantive first-level workflow request. It covers requirements, supplier screening, modular RFQ, negotiation, nomination and amendments; identifies release gates and approval layers; and provides differentiated post-nomination change lanes. The modular model addresses features, design elements, child parts and raw materials, including quantity/unit fields, recurring versus one-time costs, price roll-ups, validity and double-counting prevention. The platform blueprint specifies linked records, lifecycle states, electronic approvals, audit history, routing and stakeholder dashboards. Open implementation decisions are identified without suspending existing approvals. Reviews are limited to affected requirements where appropriate, so the controls do not impose an unnecessary blanket restart. This is a substantive-content judgment: the supplied extract does not establish rendered pagination, visual quality, file readability or human acceptance. The requested two-to-three-page limit remains a separate pending engineering check, not an observed content failure.
